data.body:
[P2] Preserve the advertised AI errors across the step boundary

When `ask` throws `LlmStoppedError` or `LlmMaxTokensError`, the core step handler reconstructs it through `DurableOperationError.fromErrorObject`, returning `StepError` even on the initial execution. The decider operations behave identically. Callers therefore cannot catch the exported AI classes, and `status`/`stopReason` are lost. The missing-SDK tests conceal this by replacing `context.step` with a direct function call. Preserve the AI error metadata and restore the advertised classes at the operation boundary, with runner-based tests for execution and replay.
